uncertain.why: Small stacked marks: damma on ح clear; a fatha-over-shadda cluster sits over the م/ي junction, so it is unclear whether it is مَيّ or مَيَّ (no sukun on ث visible).

print_errors.note: Hijri year printed without هـ, unlike all the other dates; kept as printed.
إلي printed with dotted ي several times (alongside إلى); kept as printed.
Grammatically ثلاثة وعشرين expected; kept as printed.
Only a sukun is printed over the lam-mim (no vowel on م), and sukun on ج; kept as printed.
Final م of العظيم unvowelled and ق of أحق has shadda without vowel; kept as printed.

notes: p173 continues the isnad sentence from p172 (ends «القطب الإمام أبي»), so marked +. pp.174-175 also continue mid-sentence. p174 «و«صغرى» shows a small gap between و and «; written attached. p176 heading line «للسيد عبدالله الصِدّيق الغماري»: kasra under ص and shadda on د as printed. Bold on p173 «وهنا تجتمع الطرق كلها» with the period kept outside the bold.
